description: Whose birthday is coming up or was just missed: the user's contacts with a birthday in a window (days_back before and days_ahead after today, 30 each, or from/to), in the account timezone. upcoming (days_until) and recent (days_since), soonest first then closest: birthday_on, age_turning (null when the year is unknown), birthday_precision, relationship, tier, is_favorite, last_in_touch, in_touch_since_birthday. Counts contacts without a birthday. Excludes Me, never-share and deceased contacts (include_deceased adds them as remembrance). ($0.05; API key required)

days_back.description: Days before today, for missed birthdays (default 30).

include_deceased.description: Add deceased contacts, marked remembrance (default false).

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (instead of days_ahead). At most 366 days in all.

name: get_birthdays

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

inspect_note.description: How to cite: link each record with its inspect_url, never a link built from an id; which record types here have no Dayze page.

missing_birthdays.description: { count, hint }: contacts without a birthday in Dayze.

items.description: A birthday already passed in the window (days_since).
A birthday today or later in the window (days_until).

window.description: { from, to }: the inclusive civil window.

without_day.description: { count, hint }: contacts with only a birth year or year and month.

title: Get Birthdays
